problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must allocate a series of freight shipments onto identical cargo aircraft. The shipments are as follows:

* Shipment Alpha: mass 44 metric tons
* Shipment Bravo: mass 43 metric tons
* Shipment Charlie: mass 34 metric tons
* Shipment Delta: mass 57 metric tons
* Shipment Echo: mass 52 metric tons
* Shipment Foxtrot: mass 64 metric tons
* Shipment Golf: mass 34 metric tons
* Shipment Hotel: mass 40 metric tons
* Shipment India: mass 41 metric tons
* Shipment Juliet: mass 70 metric tons
* Shipment Kilo: mass 69 metric tons
* Shipment Lima: mass 44 metric tons
* Shipment Mike: mass 65 metric tons
* Shipment November: mass 35 metric tons
* Shipment Oscar: mass 48 metric tons
* Shipment Papa: mass 62 metric tons
* Shipment Quebec: mass 54 metric tons
* Shipment Romeo: mass 33 metric tons
* Shipment Sierra: mass 70 metric tons
* Shipment Tango: mass 52 metric tons
* Shipment Uniform: mass 43 metric tons
* Shipment Victor: mass 59 metric tons
* Shipment Whiskey: mass 67 metric tons
* Shipment X-ray: mass 66 metric tons
* Shipment Yankee: mass 42 metric tons
* Shipment Zulu: mass 59 metric tons
* Shipment [Bravo]: mass 62 metric tons
* Shipment [Charlie]: mass 36 metric tons
* Shipment [Delta]: mass 58 metric tons
* Shipment [Echo]: mass 42 metric tons
* Shipment [Foxtrot]: mass 52 metric tons
* Shipment [Golf]: mass 68 metric tons
* Shipment [Hotel]: mass 50 metric tons
* Shipment [India]: mass 51 metric tons
* Shipment [Juliet]: mass 68 metric tons
* Shipment [Kilo]: mass 69 metric tons

Each aircraft has a maximum payload capacity of 100 metric tons. The coordinator must assign all shipments to aircraft, with every shipment placed on exactly one aircraft and the combined mass on any given aircraft not surpassing its limit, while striving to utilize the smallest possible fleet of aircraft.
